content_of_post_to_answer: Do you prefer to stay busy with physical chores or creative hobbies when you feel a bout of overthinking starting?
answer: I think the choice between chores and creative hobbies depends on what kind of overthinking is happening. Physical tasks can interrupt a mental loop by bringing attention back to the body, while creative work can transform the thoughts into something meaningful. The mistake is treating all overthinking as a problem to silence; sometimes it is unfinished thinking asking for a different outlet. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone interested. The goal is not to escape your mind, but to give it a better place to go.
